newsitem.title: USA: ISG stake raised by Dawson-Samberg group.
newsitem.headline: ISG stake raised by Dawson-Samberg group.

text.p: A group led by Dawson-Samberg Capital Management Inc said Monday it increased its stake in ISG International Software Group Ltd to 776,000 common shares or 9.9 percent from 8.84 percent previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net of 83,500 common shares bought between December 11 and December 20 at prices ranging from $20.1110 to $29.8068 per share.
The group bought the shares in the Israel-based corporation for investment purposes.
Based in Haifa, ISG develops, markets and supports computer software productivity tools and system utilities.
